question: What is the meaning of use of easily recyclable materials in relation to design for recycling?
description: Design for recycling refers to the intentional design of products or materials with the aim of making them easier to recycle at the end of their life cycle. When easily recyclable materials are used in relation to design for recycling, it means that the materials chosen can be efficiently and effectively recycled into new products or materials without losing their quality or value. This approach aligns with the principles of a circular economy by promoting the reuse of materials and reducing waste.
